mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_group (group_id, group_name, owner_id, avatar) VALUES (#{g.groupId}, #{g.groupName}, #{g.ownerId}, #{g.avatar})
INSERT INTO chat_group_member (group_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE join_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT group_id AS groupId, group_name AS groupName, avatar AS avatar, create_time AS createTime FROM chat_group WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT user_id FROM chat_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT group_id FROM chat_group_member WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT g.group_id AS groupId, g.group_name AS groupName, g.avatar AS avatar, g.owner_id AS ownerId, g.create_time AS createTime FROM chat_group g JOIN chat_group_member m ON g.group_id = m.group_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_group_cursor (user_id, group_id, last_read_msg_id, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{groupId}, #{lastReadMsgId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_msg_id = VALUES(last_read_msg_id), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT create_time FROM chat_message WHERE msg_id = #{lastCursor} AND cmd = 3 LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message cm LEFT JOIN chat_group_cursor c ON cm.group_id = c.group_id AND c.user_id = #{userId} WHERE cm.group_id = #{groupId} AND cm.cmd = 3 AND cm.create_time > COALESCE(c.update_time, '1970-01-01')
SELECT * FROM chat_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT owner_id FROM chat_group WHERE group_id = #{groupId} LIMIT 1
